name: elite/Request smuggling CL.TE timing oracle
description: [critical] Kettle's differential-timing CL.TE detection (PortSwigger Academy probe, exact bytes): POST with Transfer-Encoding chunked + Content-Length 4 and body '1\r\nA\r\nX' — front-end (CL) truncates, back-end (TE) waits for the next chunk -> response hangs on the timeout. Keywords: request smuggling desync cl.te timing proxy reverse. ctrl: benign fast POST fails the latency condition -> not falsified. probe_url = site root. SLOW probe: hang lasts one back-end timeout (~10s+); use trials=2 need=2. Requires the sandbox/curl path (host-side requests rewrites Content-Length). Follow-up: same-connection response-differential probe needs a raw-socket fetch primitive (not expressible in this DSL).
